OPTIONAL MATCH (from_party:Party)<-[:FROM]-(t)
OPTIONAL MATCH (to_party:Party)<-[:TO]-(t)

OPTIONAL MATCH (claim)-[cb:CLEARED_BY]->(doc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[au:ACTED_UNDER]->(auth:Authority)
OPTIONAL MATCH (auth)-[gb:GRANTED_BY]->(grantor:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (auth)-[rb:REVOKED_BY]->(revDoc:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[eb:EVIDENCED_BY]->(pass:Passage)
RETURN asset.id AS asset, t.id AS transfer, t.effective AS effective, t.recorded AS recorded,
       t.by_agent AS agent, t.odometer AS odometer, t.title_branded AS branded,
       from_party.name AS fromName, to_party.name AS toName, prev.id AS follows,
       claim.kind AS claimKind, claim.holder AS claimHolder, claim.effective AS claimEffective,
       doc.kind AS clearDocKind, doc.effective AS clearDocEffective,
       auth.valid_from AS authFrom, auth.valid_to AS authTo, auth.scope AS authScope,
       grantor.name AS grantorName, pass.id AS passageId, pass.text AS passageText

MATCH (a:Asset {id: 'A1'})<-[:MOVES]-(t:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[f:FOLLOWS]->(prev:Transfer)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[from:FROM]-(seller:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[to:TO]->(buyer:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[au:ACTED_UNDER]->(auth:Authority)
OPTIONAL MATCH (auth)-[gb:GRANTED_BY]->(grantor:Party)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Claim)-[ag:AGAINST]->(t)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[cb:CLEARED_BY]->(rel:Document)
RETURN t.id AS transfer, t.effective AS effective, t.recorded AS recorded, 
       seller.name AS seller, buyer.name AS buyer, t.by_agent AS agent,
       c.kind AS claim_kind, c.holder AS claim_holder, c.effective AS claim_effective,
       rel.kind AS release_kind, rel.effective AS release_effective
ORDER BY t.effective ASC
